GET /api/engagements/:id/invoice.note: The engagement's founder side (founder_id) and partner side (partner_id) read the invoice. Another founder, another partner, an investor, a revoked advisor, an admin and the Super Admin get the same 404 a missing engagement gets; no credentials or a disabled partner get 401.

POST /api/engagements/:id/invoice/paid.note: Only the engagement's partner (partner_id) marks the invoice paid. The founder side, another partner, every non-party, an admin and the Super Admin get 403 and the invoice stays issued; no credentials or a disabled partner get 401. See D4570-p6, hardening item 1, on the 403.
